correctness.rationale: Exact distance cases show MMD pairs exactly disjoint old edges for all \(n\ge4\). Classical strong resolving graph/vertex cover equivalence (read at arXiv:2309.17419v2 Thm 3.8, arXiv:1612.02843v1 Sec 1.3) and directly proved star/triangle maximal-intersecting classification yield all minimal sets, counts, edge cases and gaps. An independent finite verifier directly tests MMD for n=4..7, all edge families n=4..7 and original strong resolving condition n=4,5. Finite tests are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: Determines all inclusion-minimal strong resolving sets and their full cardinality polynomial on the natural once-subdivided complete graphs; two distinct structural families have an unbounded \(n-4\) size gap and \(n-5\) absent cardinalities. The study of minimal strong resolving-set enumeration (arxiv:2309.17419) directly motivates the exact family classification, beyond a lone minimum-cardinality computation.
